name: schur
expr: [U, T] = schur(S); err = max(max(abs(U*T*U' - S))); off_diag = max(max(abs(T - diag(diag(T)))));
comment: Sig: [U, T] = schur(A). For symmetric A this is the eigendecomposition: A = U*T*U' with T diagonal. General (non-symmetric) Schur returns quasi-triangular T with 2x2 blocks for complex eigenpairs -- deferred to Phase 2b. Eigenvalues bit-identical with MATLAB.
